name: garlic
description: Ward off AI burnout. garlic tracks the time you spend in Claude Code against the time your agents run, deduplicated across parallel sessions, and shows it in a small panel with break nudges you can pause or reset. Open the panel with /garlic. Requires the garlic binary on PATH (brew install --cask justanotherspy/tap/garlic, or cargo install garlic-ward).

status_line.title: Status line
status_line.description: Keep today's time on the status line under the prompt.
